name: Maxma
summary: An AI marketing teammate that analyses paid-ad performance, creates ads and landing pages, launches and optimises campaigns across Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, with your approval.
description: An AI marketing teammate that analyses paid-ad performance, creates ads and landing pages, launches and optimises campaigns across Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, with your approval.

pricing.details: 30-day trial with full Pro access (load 18 € of credits, pay usage only). Starter 88 €/month (up to 17,835 € ad spend); Standard 267 €/month (up to 44,587 € ad spend); Pro 802 €/month (up to 178,348 € ad spend); Enterprise custom. Add-ons: incrementality test from 445 €/test; marketing-mix model from 1,694 €/month.
pricing.label: Premium
